Sam: Heads-up — KMS audit is showing ~3k KMS_DECRYPT_FAILURE events against projects/redwood-staging/keys/vault-wrap-key in the last 24h. Looks like CI uploaded wrapped blobs into a public bucket and some consumers keep trying to decrypt stale blobs.
Maria: Ugh. Do we know which CI job pushed them?
Sam: Quick grep shows path: gs://staging-artifacts/build-logs/*/step-output.txt contains base64 ciphertext that matches our transit-wrapped format. Example snippet: `vault:v1:AAAAB3NzaC1yc2...`
Jamie: That explains the repeated decrypt attempts — downstream tasks keep pulling logs and attempting rewrap/decrypt. Could be just noise but blast radius includes staging DB creds if any blob contained secrets.
Leo: First containment: can we rotate the KMS wrapping key and change Vault's transit key to a new key that only vault-proxy SA can access? That prevents further successful decrypts.
Maria: Agreed. Short plan: 1) Create new KMS key `vault-wrap-key-rot1` in same region. 2) Update Vault transit config to use the new key (do a safe switchover). 3) Rewrap stored ciphertext via Vault's rewrap endpoint. 4) Remove broad IAM on old key and restrict to vault-sa and sec-admins.
Sam: Also enable finer audit export for KMS and Vault to BigQuery for queryable provenance — want to know which runner/service account uploaded the offending logs.
Jamie: Who can own the rotation ops? I can spin up the rewrap job but need IAM help for key creation and to patch vault config in infra.
Maria: I can handle IAM changes + KMS key creation. Leo, can you coordinate the Vault-side change and the rewrap job?
Leo: Yes. For rewrap I'll run a controlled job that reads ciphertext from storage and calls `vault/rewrap` per-object in batches. Will throttle to avoid load spikes. Example psuedo: ```for obj in list(gs://staging-artifacts/build-logs/): ct = read(obj) vault write transit/rewrap ciphertext=$ct destination_key=vault-wrap-key-rot1 upload(obj, ct_new)```
Sam: Before rewrap we should snapshot current ciphertexts (export) and mark a maintenance window for any consumers that expect immediate decrypts. Otherwise callers will fail while we switch.
Maria: RBAC note: current IAM binding includes `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` for `ci-runner@partners` — that needs removal ASAP. I'll prepare a least-priv policy: only `serviceAccount:vault-sa@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com` and `group:secops@redwood` keep decrypt.
Jamie: Also add a logging sink from Cloud Audit Logs to the sec-bq dataset: filter protoPayload.methodName: "google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt" to capture attempts and principals.
Sam: Good. We should also mark any logs with repeated failures as potentially exfil attempts and notify legal/partners if runner belongs to third-party.
DevSecBot: Created incident INC-2026-0892 (severity: medium) and a task board card: "staging-wrapped-blob-rotation". Assignments: Maria (IAM/KMS), Leo (Vault rewrap), Jamie (replay detection + consumer whitelist).
Jamie: Quick question on rewrap — do we have permission to rewrap without exposing plaintext? Vault transit supports server-side rewrap so plaintext never leaves Vault. Confirm before running.
Leo: Confirmed — using `rewrap` endpoint does not return plaintext. Will test on a subset first (`gs://staging-artifacts/build-logs/test-sample/`).
Maria: Timeline: IAM lockdown in next 30m, KMS key create in 1h, Vault switchover & test rewrap in 2h, full rewrap over 6h window. Posting change windows to #release-war-room.
Sam: Also need to add automated detection rule to reduce noise: if decrypt_failures from same principal > X in 1h then silence after triage, else alert. Jamie can you propose thresholds?
Jamie: I'll draft threshold proposal (default: 100 failures/hr triggers an alert, 500/hr triggers pager). Putting PR up for alerting rules.
Sam: Thanks. After rewrap and IAM changes, we'll run an artifact scan to detect any other public buckets with wrapped blobs. I can run a quick gsutil grep across known buckets.
Leo: Test results: rewrap sample passed, no plaintext returned. Proceeding with batch rewrap at +2h.
Maria: IAM change applied to remove `ci-runner@partners` decrypt permission. :lock:
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-0892 updated: severity -> medium, status -> investigating.
Sam: Nice. After rotation, schedule a follow-up audit to confirm no live decrypts from non-vault principals for 7 days. Also add regression alert if any new public artifacts appear.
Jamie: Copy. I'll handle the alert PR and the audit query examples for the runbook. :thumbsup:
Maria: File notes and timeline in the incident doc. If partner communication needed, ping me.
Sam: Thanks everyone — keeping channel for updates. :eyes:
